name: ¿Y este USB?
source:
Is it the USB of a stalker? Or your best friend?

Gene, an applied student, finds a USB with photos of himself.
His friend, Vec, presses him to look for the owner.
But will the USB belong to a stalker, or will it be your best friend's?
It is up to you to discover the truth behind the USB.

[Edited from [url=https://lakirly.itch.io/y-este-usb]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是跟踪者的U盘，还是你最好朋友的U盘？

应用系学生吉恩发现了一个装有自己照片的U盘。朋友韦克催促他寻找失主。

但这个U盘究竟属于跟踪者，还是属于你最好的朋友？

U盘背后的真相，等你亲自发现。

[改编自[url=https://lakirly.itch.io/y-este-usb]Itch.io[/url]]
